# Domain Registrar Reference

## Recommended Registrars

Each entry is the registrar, what it is best for, its pros, then its cons.

- **Cloudflare** — at-cost pricing. No markup, same renewal price, free
  privacy; you must add the zone first.
- **Spaceship** — cheapest prices. Often lowest .ai/.io prices, clean UI; a
  newer company.
- **NameSilo** — consistent pricing. Low renewal, bulk discounts; basic UI.
- **Porkbun** — budget friendly. Good prices, fun branding, free SSL; limited
  enterprise features.
- **Namecheap** — features. Free WhoisGuard year 1, good support; renewal can
  be higher.
- **Dynadot** — domain auctions. Good aftermarket, bulk tools; dated
  interface.
- **GoDaddy** — avoid. Name recognition; high renewal, upsells.

## Price Tiers by TLD

### Premium TLDs (rarely have promos)
- **.ai** - $65-80/year (Anguilla ccTLD, 2-year min)
- **.io** - $35-50/year (British Indian Ocean Territory)
- **.co** - $25-35/year (Colombia)

### Standard TLDs
- **.com** - $9-14/year
- **.net** - $12-16/year
- **.org** - $10-14/year

### Budget TLDs
- **.xyz** - $1-10/year
- **.club** - $1-5/year
- **.site** - $1-5/year
